renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Twenty when-questions that are really one: when will longing become meeting — asked of mind, face, gods, world, yoga, pride, tears, beast-life, play, speech (vv1-19). [1] Answered once, in the last verse: by hugging hard and seeing without effort — strainless full beholding (v20).

paragraphs.text: Twenty questions that are really one question, asked of everything in turn. When will my mind, keen to taste the wet-and-wet wedding of fresh sap, rush past all else to Your touch? Dyed with You alone, rich only in Your foot-worship: when shall I see You face to face, I, keen? By thick love grown past caring: when, crash, all great bolts burst, shall I near You? Heart-throned in Your knowing’s pith, all gods: when, by Your love’s might, shall I bring them neath my spell? When be my love-bliss-sap teeming feast, where apartness itself takes name from beholding-joy? The Lord, fearless, lavish, full, causeless, self-denied, known in a flash: when shall I shame the Master’s men? When, Lord, shall I win that belovedness of Yours whereby from me nowhere flight were fit for You? All breathing things, truth-told, Your-worship-made selves: by their applauding-glance-sap flooded may I be — when, All? Knowing’s highest ground, yoga’s highest pitch, Your love: when be my begging full? Seizing sudden, gripping hard, joy-helpless I: when shall Your foot-treasure-choice to all be shown? Round about Your-shine-spread: when be I so, Ruler, no Maya-shade-pit in me may be? All circles made my own, past needing: when, Lord, be I Your lover-host’s head? Lord, of world-prides the unheard ground: great-pride when be I, Your love-sap-filled? Well-set in never-empty glory-embrace: may I lie as at Your cool foot-lotus pair — when? Your worship-joy-wealth, rich with love-wine: when fare I to its far shore, when be done? Tears first, tripping, reeling, choked-wailing, laughter-lit face: Your touch-sap when win I? This beast-folk-like state shaken off: when, Kind One, taste I my self-shape, worthy Your lovers? Powers won, all fever-fear melted: on Your love-elixir-drink-play bent, when be I? Lord, when shall that wail of mine ring so in speech — Your shape straightway flashing before me?

Answered once, in the last verse. Mind set on clasping Your foot-lotuses hard, passion-bent: thing, unthing, this — strainless, when full-behold I You? Hug hard, see without effort: strainless full beholding.
